## Plugin reference

- Description: <AmbientField>: a living, barely-there background behind its children — hairline strands (iron filings) following a slowly turning flow, drawn on a canvas. Each pointer stroke is a magnet of its own random kind (a pole or a vortex, either sign, its own strength and reach) that turns the strands near it, then fades.
